name: 03598 · Whitefield, NH
findings: ZIP 03598 (Whitefield) has 20 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 03598 (Whitefield) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
62% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
